arithmetic_intensity.formula: 强度 = FLOPs/权重字节 = 2/(bits/8) = 16/bits(batch-1 矩阵-向量积)

paper_quotes.awq: any workload with arithmetic intensity less than 165 is memory bounded on 4090;FP16 generation stage ≈ 1;AWQ reduces the weight memory by four times(arXiv:2306.00978 §4.1, paper-awq.md:L266)
paper_quotes.gptq_kernel: quantized-matrix full-precision-vector product kernel ... dynamically dequantizing weights when needed;almost all of the speedup is due to our kernels(arXiv:2210.17323 §5, paper.md:L483)
paper_quotes.gptq_limitation: speedups from reduced memory movement, and does not lead to computational reductions(arXiv:2210.17323 §6, paper.md:L508)

gate_1_config_min_capability.what: config 期算力硬门:get_min_capability 不满足直接 ValueError(docstring 自述门槛 due to the custom CUDA kernels)

gate_2_constructor_choose_kernel.what: 构造期 choose_mp_linear_kernel 按平台优先级表逐个过三道闸(黑名单/算力/can_implement),第一个全过的中选,构造期一次定死

same_checkpoint_different_gpu.verdict: H100(cap 90)过 Machete 门 --> Machete;A100(cap 80 < 90)被算力闸拦下 --> 落到 Marlin(75 <= 80)——同一 GPTQ 检查点两张卡两个 kernel

gate_3_loadtime_repack.what: 装载期 process_weights_after_loading:全模型遍历,把检查点格式重排成 kernel 格式(Marlin repack/FP8 转置合并/NVFP4 alpha 预计算)

gate_4_compile_time_ops.what: 编译期算子选择:块状权重强制 +quant_fp8 手工算子;query 量化刻意用普通 torch 算子让 compile 融合;fuse_norm_quant/fuse_act_quant/fuse_attn_quant 按 -O 档位与硬件谓词启用
gate_4_compile_time_ops.ch19_payoff: F10 伏笔(ch19 埋:planted=19, 本章收:paid=27)——三影子的选择标准都是『哪条路对整条编译管线更快』
